title.zh: 卷六十二 表第二 宰相中
title.raw: 卷六十二 表第二 宰相中 Volume 62 Tables 2: Chancellors 2

meta.sourceNote: Body replaced from Wikisource raw text after ChineseNotes scrape due to glyph/encoding artifacts.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥，吏部尚書蕭至忠為中書令。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day yihai, Xiao Zhizhong, minister of the civil service, was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on yihai, Xiao Zhizhong, minister of the civil service, was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰，兵部尚書郭元振同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingchen, Guo Yuanzhen, minister of war, was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingchen, Guo Yuanzhen, minister of war, was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，至忠、羲誅，懷貞自殺。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi, Xiao Zhizhong and Cen Yi were executed; Dou Huaizhen committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi, Xiao Zhizhong and Cen Yi were put to death; Dou Huaizhen took his own life.

sentences.zh: 庚午，湜流竇州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Cui Shi was exiled to Dou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Cui Shi was banished to Dou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，說檢校中書令。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Zhang Shuo was made acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Shuo was appointed acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，象先罷為益州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Lu Xiangxian was removed and made chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Lu Xiangxian was dismissed and appointed chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，幽求為尚書右僕射，知軍國重事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guisi, Liu Youqiu was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with weighty affairs of state and military.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guisi, Liu Youqiu was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and charged with weighty affairs of state and military.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，說為中書令，幽求同三品。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengwu, Zhang Shuo was made secretariat director; Liu Youqiu was made as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengwu, Zhang Shuo was appointed secretariat director, and Liu Youqiu was appointed as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，元振流於新州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day guimao, Guo Yuanzhen was exiled to Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on guimao, Guo Yuanzhen was banished to Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，同州刺史姚元之為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Tong Prefecture, was made minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yao Yuanzhi, prefect of Tong Prefecture, was appointed minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，幽求兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day chou, Liu Youqiu was made concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on chou, Liu Youqiu was appointed concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，元之兼紫微令。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renyin, Yao Yuanzhi was made concurrently director of the Purple Micro Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renyin, Yao Yuanzhi was appointed concurrently director of the Purple Micro Department.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，幽求罷為太子少師，說貶為相州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Liu Youqiu was removed and made junior tutor of the crown prince; Zhang Shuo was demoted to prefect of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Liu Youqiu was dismissed and appointed junior tutor of the crown prince, and Zhang Shuo was demoted to prefect of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，黃門侍郎盧懷慎同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Lu Huaishen, vice director of the Chancellery, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Lu Huaishen, vice director of the Chancellery, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，宋王成器為太尉，申王撝為司徒，邠王守禮為司空。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renyin, Prince of Song Chengqi was made grand commandant; Prince of Shen Hui was made minister of education; Prince of Bin Shouli was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renyin, Prince of Song Chengqi was appointed grand commandant, Prince of Shen Hui minister of education, and Prince of Bin Shouli minister of works.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，宋王憲罷為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingyin, Prince of Song Xian was removed and made grand master with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingyin, Prince of Song Xian was dismissed and appointed grand master with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 正月己卯，懷慎檢校黃門監。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day jimao, Lu Huaishen was made acting director of the Yellow Gate Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on jimao, Lu Huaishen was appointed acting director of the Yellow Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 甲申，和戎、大武諸軍節度使薛訥同紫微黃門三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Xue Ne, military commissioner of the He-Rong and Da-Wu armies, was made jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Xue Ne, military commissioner of the He-Rong and Da-Wu armies, was appointed jointly with the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 五月辛亥，知古罷守工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinhai, Wei Zhigu was removed and retained as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinhai, Wei Zhigu was dismissed and retained as minister of works.

sentences.zh: 七月，訥除名。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Xue Ne was stripped of his name and office.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Xue Ne was removed from the register and stripped of office.

sentences.zh: 正月癸卯，懷慎檢校吏部尚書兼黃門監。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day guimao, Lu Huaishen was made acting minister of the civil service and concurrently director of the Yellow Gate Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on guimao, Lu Huaishen was appointed acting minister of the civil service and concurrently director of the Yellow Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 正月丙申，懷慎檢校吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day bingshen, Lu Huaishen was made acting minister of the civil service.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on bingshen, Lu Huaishen was appointed acting minister of the civil service.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，懷慎去官養疾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jimao, Lu Huaishen left office to nurse illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jimao, Lu Huaishen resigned to tend his illness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，尚書左丞源乾曜為黃門侍郎、同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Yuan Gan'yao, left director of the Department of State Affairs, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Yuan Gan'yao, left director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月己亥，元之、幽求罷為開府儀同三司，乾曜罷為京兆尹。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month on the day jihai, Yao Yuanzhi and Liu Youqiu were removed and made grand masters with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies; Yuan Gan'yao was removed and made chief administrator of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month on jihai, Yao Yuanzhi and Liu Youqiu were dismissed and appointed grandees with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and Yuan Gan'yao was dismissed and appointed chief administrator of the capital.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書宋璟為吏部尚書兼黃門監，紫微侍郎蘇頲同紫微黃門平章事。

translations.literal: Song Jing, minister of justice, was made minister of the civil service and concurrently director of the Yellow Gate Department; Su Ting, vice secretary of the Purple Micro Department, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jing, minister of justice, was appointed minister of the civil service and concurrently director of the Yellow Gate Department; Su Ting, vice secretary of the Purple Micro Department, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Purple Micro and Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 正月辛巳，頲罷為禮部尚書，璟罷為開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day xinsi, Su Ting was removed and made minister of rites; Song Jing was removed and made grand master with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on xinsi, Su Ting was dismissed and appointed minister of rites, and Song Jing was dismissed and appointed grand master with imperial ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹源乾曜為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事，并州大都督府長史張嘉貞守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Yuan Gan'yao, chief administrator of the capital, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Zhang Jiazhen, chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Bingzhou, was made acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Gan'yao, chief administrator of the capital, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Zhang Jiazhen, chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Bingzhou, was appointed acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，乾曜為侍中，嘉貞為中書令。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day dingmao, Yuan Gan'yao was made palace attendant; Zhang Jiazhen was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingmao, Yuan Gan'yao was appointed palace attendant, and Zhang Jiazhen was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，天兵軍節度使張說守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day guihai, Zhang Shuo, military commissioner of the Tianbing Army, was made acting minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on guihai, Zhang Shuo, military commissioner of the Tianbing Army, was appointed acting minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，嘉貞貶豳州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiyou, Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to prefect of Bin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiyou, Zhang Jiazhen was demoted to prefect of Bin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，說兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhang Shuo was made concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zhang Shuo was appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 四月甲子，說為中書令，吏部尚書王晙為兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiazi, Zhang Shuo was made secretariat director; Wang Jun, minister of the civil service, was made minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiazi, Zhang Shuo was appointed secretariat director, and Wang Jun, minister of the civil service, was appointed minister of war and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，晙持節朔方節度使，兼知河北、河東、隴右、河西兵馬使，六月巡邊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jichou, Wang Jun, with full credentials as military commissioner of Shuofang, was made concurrently commissioner for Hebei, Hedong, Longyou, and Hexi military affairs and toured the frontier in the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jichou, Wang Jun was commissioned with full credentials as military commissioner of Shuofang and concurrently charged with military affairs in Hebei, Hedong, Longyou, and Hexi; in the sixth month he inspected the frontier.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，晙貶蘄州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengshen, Wang Jun was demoted to prefect of Qi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengshen, Wang Jun was demoted to prefect of Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛巳，申王撝薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day xinsi, Prince of Shen Hui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on xinsi, Prince of Shen Hui died.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，說為尚書右丞相兼中書令，乾曜為尚書左丞相兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renchen, Zhang Shuo was made right chief minister and concurrently secretariat director; Yuan Gan'yao was made left chief minister and concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renchen, Zhang Shuo was appointed right chief minister and concurrently secretariat director, and Yuan Gan'yao was appointed left chief minister and concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，戶部侍郎李元紘為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingsi, Li Yuanhong, vice minister of revenue, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingsi, Li Yuanhong, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，說罷為尚書右丞相。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengshen, Zhang Shuo was removed and made right chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengshen, Zhang Shuo was dismissed and appointed right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，磧西節度使杜暹檢校黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jichou, Du Xian, military commissioner of Qixi, was made acting vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jichou, Du Xian, military commissioner of Qixi, was appointed acting vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，河西節度使蕭嵩守兵部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guisi, Xiao Song, military commissioner of Hexi, was made acting minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guisi, Xiao Song, military commissioner of Hexi, was appointed acting minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，元紘罷為曹州刺史，乾曜罷為左丞相，暹罷為荊州大都督府長史，嵩為中書令；

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiaxu, Li Yuanhong was removed and made prefect of Cao Prefecture; Yuan Gan'yao was removed and made left chief minister; Du Xian was removed and made chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Jingzhou; Xiao Song was made secretariat director;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiaxu, Li Yuanhong was dismissed and appointed prefect of Cao Prefecture; Yuan Gan'yao was dismissed and appointed left chief minister; Du Xian was dismissed and appointed chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Jingzhou; and Xiao Song was appointed secretariat director;

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎裴光庭為中書侍郎，戶部侍郎宇文融為黃門侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Pei Guangting, vice minister of war, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Yu Wenrong, vice minister of revenue, was made vice director of the Chancellery—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Guangting, vice minister of war, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat; Yu Wenrong, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，光庭兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jimao, Pei Guangting was made concurrently censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jimao, Pei Guangting was appointed concurrently censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，融貶汝州刺史。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day renzi, Yu Wenrong was demoted to prefect of Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on renzi, Yu Wenrong was demoted to prefect of Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正月辛卯，光庭為侍中。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day xinmao, Pei Guangting was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on xinmao, Pei Guangting was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，兼吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day chou, he was made concurrently minister of the civil service.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on chou, Pei Guangting was appointed concurrently minister of the civil service.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，嵩為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renshen, Xiao Song was made minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renshen, Xiao Song was appointed minister of war.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，忠王浚為司徒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day dingchou, Prince of Zhong Jun was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on dingchou, Prince of Zhong Jun was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 三月乙巳，光庭薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day yisi, Pei Guangting died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on yisi, Pei Guangting died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，尚書右丞韓休為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Han Xiu, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Han Xiu, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，嵩罷為右丞相，休罷為檢校工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingsi, Xiao Song was removed and made right chief minister; Han Xiu was removed and made acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingsi, Xiao Song was dismissed and appointed right chief minister, and Han Xiu was dismissed and appointed acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹裴耀卿守黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事，前檢校中書侍郎起復張九齡為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Pei Yaoqing, chief administrator of the capital, was made acting vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Zhang Jiuling, former acting vice secretary of the Secretariat recalled from mourning, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Yaoqing, chief administrator of the capital, was appointed acting vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Zhang Jiuling, former acting vice secretary of the Secretariat recalled from mourning, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，宋王憲為太尉，薛王業為司徒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingsi, Prince of Song Xian was made grand commandant; Prince of Xue Ye was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingsi, Prince of Song Xian was appointed grand commandant, and Prince of Xue Ye was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，耀卿為侍中，九齡為中書令，黃門侍郎李林甫為禮部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wuzi, Pei Yaoqing was made palace attendant; Zhang Jiuling was made secretariat director; Li Linfu, vice director of the Chancellery, was made minister of rites and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuzi, Pei Yaoqing was appointed palace attendant, Zhang Jiuling secretariat director, and Li Linfu, vice director of the Chancellery, minister of rites and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，九齡為河南開稻田使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiashen, Zhang Jiuling was made commissioner for opening polder fields in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiashen, Zhang Jiuling was appointed commissioner for opening polder fields in Henan.

sentences.zh: 八月，耀卿為江淮以南回造使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Pei Yaoqing was made commissioner for reconstruction south of the Huai and Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Pei Yaoqing was appointed commissioner for reconstruction south of the Huai and Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，薛王業薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jisi, Prince of Xue Ye died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jisi, Prince of Xue Ye died.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，林甫為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renyin, Li Linfu was made minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renyin, Li Linfu was appointed minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，林甫為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengzi, Li Linfu was made minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengzi, Li Linfu was appointed minister of war.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，耀卿罷為左丞相，九齡罷為右丞相。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renyin, Pei Yaoqing was removed and made left chief minister; Zhang Jiuling was removed and made right chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renyin, Pei Yaoqing was dismissed and appointed left chief minister, and Zhang Jiuling was dismissed and appointed right chief minister.

sentences.zh: 林甫兼中書令，朔方節度使牛仙客守工部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Li Linfu was made concurrently secretariat director; Niu Xianke, military commissioner of Shuofang, was made acting minister of works and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: Li Linfu was appointed concurrently secretariat director; Niu Xianke, military commissioner of Shuofang, was appointed acting minister of works and jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，仙客知門下省事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day bingyin, Niu Xianke was made director of Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on bingyin, Niu Xianke was appointed director of Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊申，慶王琮為司徒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wushen, Prince of Qing Zong was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wushen, Prince of Qing Zong was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥，仙客守侍中。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day yihai, Niu Xianke was made acting palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on yihai, Niu Xianke was appointed acting palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 正月壬辰，林甫持節遙領隴右節度副大使，知節度事。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day renchen, Li Linfu, with full credentials, held in absentia the post of deputy commissioner of Longyou and directed military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on renchen, Li Linfu was commissioned with full credentials to hold in absentia the deputy commissionership of Longyou and to direct military affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，仙客遙領河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day maoy, Niu Xianke held in absentia the post of military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on maoy, Niu Xianke was appointed in absentia military commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，林甫遙領河西節度副大使，知節度事，仍判涼州事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day you, Li Linfu held in absentia the post of deputy military commissioner of Hexi and directed military affairs, while continuing to administer Liang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on you, Li Linfu was appointed in absentia deputy military commissioner of Hexi and director of military affairs, while continuing to administer Liang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，忠王浚為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day gengzi, Prince of Zhong Jun was made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on gengzi, Prince of Zhong Jun was appointed crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四月己丑，林甫為吏部尚書，仙客為兵部尚書兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jichou, Li Linfu was made minister of the civil service; Niu Xianke was made minister of war and concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jichou, Li Linfu was appointed minister of the civil service, and Niu Xianke was appointed minister of war and concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月，仙客罷節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Niu Xianke was removed as military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Niu Xianke was relieved of his military commissionership.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，邠王守禮薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengxu, Prince of Bin Shouli died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengxu, Prince of Bin Shouli died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，宋王憲薨。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Prince of Song Xian died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Prince of Song Xian died.

sentences.zh: 七月辛丑，仙客薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinchou, Niu Xianke died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinchou, Niu Xianke died.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，刑部侍郎李適之為左相。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day dingchou, Li Shizhi, vice minister of justice, was made left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on dingchou, Li Shizhi, vice minister of justice, was appointed left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，林甫為尚書左僕射，適之兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Li Linfu was made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Li Shizhi was made concurrently minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Li Linfu was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Li Shizhi was appointed concurrently minister of war.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，適之罷為太子少保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengyin, Li Shizhi was removed and made junior protector of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengyin, Li Shizhi was dismissed and appointed junior protector of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，門下侍郎陳希烈同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Chen Xilie, vice director of the Chancellery, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Chen Xilie, vice director of the Chancellery, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，希烈為左相兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiachen, Chen Xilie was made left chief minister and concurrently minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiachen, Chen Xilie was appointed left chief minister and concurrently minister of war.

sentences.zh: 正月丁酉，林甫遙領單於、安北副大都護，充朔方節度等使。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day dingyou, Li Linfu held in absentia the posts of deputy protector-general of Chanyu and Anbei and commissioner of Shuofang and related commands.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on dingyou, Li Linfu was appointed in absentia deputy protector-general of Chanyu and Anbei and commissioner of Shuofang and related commands.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，林甫罷都護。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingxu, Li Linfu was removed as protector-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingxu, Li Linfu was relieved of the protectorship.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，林甫死。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day maoy, Li Linfu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on maoy, Li Linfu died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，御史大夫判度支事、劍南節度使楊國忠為右相兼文部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Yang Guozhong, censor-in-chief directing revenue affairs and military commissioner of Jiannan, was made right chief minister and concurrently minister of civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Yang Guozhong, censor-in-chief directing revenue affairs and military commissioner of Jiannan, was appointed right chief minister and concurrently minister of civil affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，慶王琮薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wushen, Prince of Qing Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wushen, Prince of Qing Zong died.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，希烈為祕書省圖書使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wuzi, Chen Xilie was made commissioner of the palace library.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuzi, Chen Xilie was appointed commissioner of the palace library.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，希烈罷為太子太師。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingxu, Chen Xilie was removed and made grand tutor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingxu, Chen Xilie was dismissed and appointed grand tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 文部侍郎韋見素為武部尚書、同中書門下平章事，知門下省事。

translations.literal: Wei Jiansu, vice minister of civil affairs, was made minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and director of Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jiansu, vice minister of civil affairs, was appointed minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and director of Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月丁丑，楊國忠為司空。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingchou, Yang Guozhong was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingchou, Yang Guozhong was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，劍南節度使崔圓為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingwu, Cui Yuan, military commissioner of Jiannan, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingwu, Cui Yuan, military commissioner of Jiannan, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月甲子，憲部侍郎房琯為文部尚書，河西行軍司馬裴冕為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiazi, Fang Guan, vice minister of justice, was made minister of civil affairs; Pei Mian, campaign staff director of Hexi, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiazi, Fang Guan, vice minister of justice, was appointed minister of civil affairs; Pei Mian, campaign staff director of Hexi, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 庚午，見素為左相，蜀郡太守崔渙為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Wei Jiansu was made left chief minister; Cui Huan, prefect of Shu Commandery, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wei Jiansu was appointed left chief minister; Cui Huan, prefect of Shu Commandery, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，見素、琯、渙赴靈武。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengzi, Wei Jiansu, Fang Guan, and Cui Huan went to Lingwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengzi, Wei Jiansu, Fang Guan, and Cui Huan proceeded to Lingwu.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，憲部尚書李麟同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jiayin, Li Lin, minister of justice, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jiayin, Li Lin, minister of justice, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，渙為江南宣慰使。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Cui Huan was made commissioner for pacification of Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Cui Huan was appointed commissioner for pacification of Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，國忠死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingshen, Yang Guozhong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingshen, Yang Guozhong died.

sentences.zh: 正月甲寅，圓自蜀來。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day jiayin, Cui Yuan returned from Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on jiayin, Cui Yuan returned from Shu.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，見素罷為左僕射，冕罷為右僕射。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinyou, Wei Jiansu was removed and made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Pei Mian was removed and made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinyou, Wei Jiansu was dismissed and appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Pei Mian was dismissed and appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 憲部尚書致仕苗晉卿為左相。

translations.literal: Miao Jinqing, retired minister of justice, was made left chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Jinqing, retired minister of justice, was appointed left chief minister.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，琯罷為太子少師。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day dingsi, Fang Guan was removed and made junior tutor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on dingsi, Fang Guan was dismissed and appointed junior tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 諫議大夫兼侍御史張鎬為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zhang Hao, remonstrance official and concurrently palace censor, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao, remonstrance official and concurrently palace censor, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，渙罷為左散騎常侍、餘杭郡太守。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiashen, Cui Huan was removed and made left attendant-in-ordinary and prefect of Yuhang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiashen, Cui Huan was dismissed and appointed left attendant-in-ordinary and prefect of Yuhang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 鎬兼河南節度使，都統淮南諸軍事。

translations.literal: Zhang Hao was made concurrently military commissioner of Henan and commander-in-chief of Huainan military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Hao was appointed concurrently military commissioner of Henan and commander-in-chief of Huainan military affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，晉卿為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jiayin, Miao Jinqing was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiayin, Miao Jinqing was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，圓為中書令，麟同中書門下三品，晉卿行侍中。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Cui Yuan was made secretariat director; Li Lin was made jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank; Miao Jinqing acted as palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Cui Yuan was appointed secretariat director; Li Lin was appointed jointly with the Secretariat and Chancellery as Third Rank; and Miao Jinqing acted as palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，朔方節度使、同平章事郭子儀為司空。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuyin, Guo Ziyi, military commissioner of Shuofang and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuyin, Guo Ziyi, military commissioner of Shuofang and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，子儀罷司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jiazi, Guo Ziyi was removed as minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiazi, Guo Ziyi was relieved of the ministry of works.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，河東節度使、同平章事李光弼守司空，子儀為司徒，廣平郡王俶為太尉，進封楚王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wuwu, Li Guangbi, military commissioner of Hedong and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made acting minister of works; Guo Ziyi was made minister of education; Li Chu, Prince of Guangping, was made grand commandant and advanced in rank to Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuwu, Li Guangbi, military commissioner of Hedong and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed acting minister of works; Guo Ziyi minister of education; and Li Chu, Prince of Guangping, grand commandant and advanced in rank to Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，鎬罷為荊州大都督府長史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day wuzi, Zhang Hao was removed and made chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on wuzi, Zhang Hao was dismissed and appointed chief administrator of the Great Area Command of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，圓罷為太子少師，麟罷為太子少傅。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Cui Yuan was removed and made junior tutor of the crown prince; Li Lin was removed and made junior preceptor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Cui Yuan was dismissed and appointed junior tutor of the crown prince, and Li Lin was dismissed and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿王嶼為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Yu, vice minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu, vice minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，楚王俶封成王。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiaxu, Li Chu, Prince of Chu, was enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiaxu, Li Chu, Prince of Chu, was enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，俶為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengyin, Li Chu was made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengyin, Li Chu was appointed crown prince.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，光弼為侍中，子儀兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingchen, Li Guangbi was made palace attendant; Guo Ziyi was made concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingchen, Li Guangbi was appointed palace attendant, and Guo Ziyi was appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，兵部侍郎呂諲同中書門下平章事，判度支。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiawu, Lü Yin, vice minister of war, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery and director of the revenue bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiawu, Lü Yin, vice minister of war, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery and director of the revenue bureau.

sentences.zh: 乙未，晉卿罷為太子太傅，嶼罷為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Miao Jinqing was removed and made grand preceptor of the crown prince; Wang Yu was removed and made minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Miao Jinqing was dismissed and appointed grand preceptor of the crown prince, and Wang Yu was dismissed and appointed minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫、京兆尹李峴為吏部尚書，中書舍人李揆為中書侍郎，戶部侍郎第五琦，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Xian, censor-in-chief and chief administrator of the capital, was made minister of the civil service; Li Kui, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Di Wuqi, vice minister of revenue—all Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xian, censor-in-chief and chief administrator of the capital, was appointed minister of the civil service; Li Kui, drafting officer of the Secretariat, vice secretary of the Secretariat; and Di Wuqi, vice minister of revenue—all as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月辛巳，峴貶蜀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day xinsi, Li Xian was demoted to prefect of Shu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on xinsi, Li Xian was demoted to prefect of Shu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月辛卯，諲以母喪罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinmao, Lü Yin was removed on account of his mother's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinmao, Lü Yin left office on account of his mother's mourning.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌，起復。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renxu, he was recalled from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renxu, Lü Yin was recalled from mourning.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚午，琦貶忠州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengwu, Di Wuqi was demoted to prefect of Zhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengwu, Di Wuqi was demoted to prefect of Zhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲午，諲充勾當度支使；

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jiawu, Lü Yin served as director of revenue affairs;
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jiawu, Lü Yin was appointed director of revenue affairs;

sentences.zh: 丙午，為黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, he was made vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Lü Yin was appointed vice director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，晉卿為侍中。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingwu, Miao Jinqing was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingwu, Miao Jinqing was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬子，諲罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Lü Yin was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Lü Yin was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 正月辛巳，光弼加太尉兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day xinsi, Li Guangbi was advanced to grand commandant and concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on xinsi, Li Guangbi was advanced to grand commandant and appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丁卯，河東節度副大使王思禮為司空。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fourth month on the day dingmao, Wang Sili, deputy military commissioner of Hedong, was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month on dingmao, Wang Sili, deputy military commissioner of Hedong, was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，揆貶袁州長史。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guiwei, Li Kui was demoted to chief administrator of Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guiwei, Li Kui was demoted to chief administrator of Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 河中節度使蕭華為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Xiao Hua, military commissioner of Hezhong, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Hua, military commissioner of Hezhong, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，吏部侍郎裴遵慶為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiwei, Pei Zunqing, vice minister of the civil service, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiwei, Pei Zunqing, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，光弼罷太尉，復兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day wuxu, Li Guangbi was removed as grand commandant and again made concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wuxu, Li Guangbi was relieved of the grand commandantship and again appointed concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，光弼復為太尉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day gengzi, Li Guangbi was again made grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on gengzi, Li Guangbi was again appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 思禮薨。

translations.literal: Wang Sili died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sili died.

sentences.zh: 建辰月戊申，華罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third intercalary month on the day wushen, Xiao Hua was removed and made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the third intercalary month on wushen, Xiao Hua was dismissed and appointed minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎元載同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Yuan Zai, vice minister of revenue, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zai, vice minister of revenue, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，載行中書侍郎，勾當轉運租庸支度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingyin, Yuan Zai acted as vice secretary of the Secretariat and served as director of transport, tax, and expenditure affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingyin, Yuan Zai acted as vice secretary of the Secretariat and was appointed director of transport, tax, and expenditure affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月壬午，李輔國為司空；

translations.literal: In the first month on the day renwu, Li Fuguo was made minister of works;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on renwu, Li Fuguo was appointed minister of works;

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌，死。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renxu, he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renxu, Li Fuguo died.

sentences.zh: 正月癸未，京兆尹劉晏為吏部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day guiwei, Liu Yan, chief administrator of the capital, was made minister of the civil service and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on guiwei, Liu Yan, chief administrator of the capital, was appointed minister of the civil service and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，雍王適兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renzi, Prince of Yong Shi was made concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renzi, Prince of Yong Shi was appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，載判元帥行軍司馬。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day renchen, Yuan Zai was made director of the marshal's campaign staff.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on renchen, Yuan Zai was appointed director of the marshal's campaign staff.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，晉卿罷為太子太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day yiwei, Miao Jinqing was removed and made grand protector of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on yiwei, Miao Jinqing was dismissed and appointed grand protector of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 檢校禮部尚書李峴為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Xian, acting minister of rites, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xian, acting minister of rites, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 遵慶罷為太子少傅。

translations.literal: Pei Zunqing was removed and made junior preceptor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Zunqing was dismissed and appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未，澤潞節度使李抱玉為司空兼兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guiwei, Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Ze-Lu, was made minister of works and concurrently minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guiwei, Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Ze-Lu, was appointed minister of works and concurrently minister of war.

sentences.zh: 正月乙卯，雍王適為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day maoy, Prince of Yong Shi was made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on maoy, Prince of Yong Shi was appointed crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，峴罷為太子詹事，晏罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Li Xian was removed and made grand steward of the crown prince; Liu Yan was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Li Xian was dismissed and appointed grand steward of the crown prince, and Liu Yan was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 右散騎常侍王縉為黃門侍郎，太常卿杜鴻漸為兵部侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Wang Jin, right attendant-in-ordinary, was made vice director of the Chancellery; Du Hongjian, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice minister of war—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jin, right attendant-in-ordinary, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Du Hongjian, minister of imperial sacrifices, vice minister of war—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鴻漸加莊宅使；

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Du Hongjian was additionally made commissioner of palace estates;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Du Hongjian was additionally appointed commissioner of palace estates;

sentences.zh: 四月甲午，為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiawu, he was made vice secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiawu, Du Hongjian was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，縉為侍中，持節都統河南、淮南、淮西、山南東道行營節度事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingyin, Wang Jin was made palace attendant and, with full credentials, commander-in-chief of the Henan, Huainan, Huai-Xi, and Shannan East circuit campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingyin, Wang Jin was appointed palace attendant and, with full credentials, commander-in-chief of the Henan, Huainan, Huai-Xi, and Shannan East circuit campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬申，縉罷侍中；

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Wang Jin was removed as palace attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Wang Jin was relieved of the palace attendancy;

sentences.zh: 甲午，兼東都留守。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, he was made concurrently eastern capital intendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Wang Jin was appointed concurrently eastern capital intendant.

sentences.zh: 四月壬午，朔方行營節度使、尚書左僕射、同平章事兼太保僕固懷恩為太保。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day renwu, Pugu Huai'en, campaign military commissioner of Shuofang, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and concurrently grand guardian, was made grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renwu, Pugu Huai'en, campaign military commissioner of Shuofang, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and concurrently grand guardian, was appointed grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 七月乙酉，光弼薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yiyou, Li Guangbi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yiyou, Li Guangbi died.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，子儀為太尉，抱玉為司徒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day xinhai, Guo Ziyi was made grand commandant; Li Baoyu was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinhai, Guo Ziyi was appointed grand commandant, and Li Baoyu was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，子儀讓，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Guo Ziyi declined and was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Guo Ziyi declined the appointment and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑，子儀為尚書令。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day chou, Guo Ziyi was made director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on chou, Guo Ziyi was appointed director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，子儀讓，罷之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Guo Ziyi declined and was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Guo Ziyi again declined and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，縉為河南副元帥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengchen, Wang Jin was made deputy commander-in-chief of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengchen, Wang Jin was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of Henan.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，懷恩死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dingyou, Pugu Huai'en died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingyou, Pugu Huai'en died.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，抱玉讓司徒。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day bingwu, Li Baoyu declined the ministry of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingwu, Li Baoyu declined the ministry of education.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，鴻漸為黃門侍郎、同中書門下平章事，兼成都尹，持節山南西道、劍南東川西川、邛南、西山等道副元帥，仍充劍南西川節度副大使。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day renzi, Du Hongjian was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, concurrently prefect of Chengdu, with full credentials as deputy commander-in-chief of Shannan West, eastern and western Sichuan, Qiongnan, and western mountain circuits, and deputy military commissioner of Jiannan West.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on renzi, Du Hongjian was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, concurrently prefect of Chengdu, and with full credentials as deputy commander-in-chief of Shannan West, eastern and western Sichuan, Qiongnan, and western mountain circuits and deputy military commissioner of Jiannan West.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，鴻漸自劍南追至。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingxu, Du Hongjian returned from pursuit in Jiannan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingxu, Du Hongjian returned from his pursuit in Jiannan.

sentences.zh: 閏六月庚午，縉兼幽州盧龍節度使；

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month on the day gengwu, Wang Jin was made concurrently military commissioner of Youzhou and Lulong;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month on gengwu, Wang Jin was appointed concurrently military commissioner of Youzhou and Lulong;

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，兼河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengwu, he was made concurrently military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengwu, Wang Jin was appointed concurrently military commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 閏六月己酉，子儀為司徒。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month on the day jiyou, Guo Ziyi was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month on jiyou, Guo Ziyi was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 庚午，魏博節度使田承嗣為司空，兼檢校尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Tian Chengsi, military commissioner of Weibo, was made minister of works and acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Tian Chengsi, military commissioner of Weibo, was appointed minister of works and acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，鴻漸讓山、劍副元帥。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day maoy, Du Hongjian declined the deputy command of the mountain and sword circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on maoy, Du Hongjian declined the deputy command of the mountain and sword circuits.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，縉罷副元帥、都統行營節度事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day wushen, Wang Jin was removed as deputy commander-in-chief and commander of the campaign circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on wushen, Wang Jin was relieved of the deputy command and overall direction of the campaign circuits.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，鴻漸罷。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen, Du Hongjian was removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen, Du Hongjian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，載權知門下省事。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Yuan Zai acted as director of Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Yuan Zai acted as director of Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙子，尚書左僕射裴冕為同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Pei Mian, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Pei Mian, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，冕薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wuxu, Pei Mian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuxu, Pei Mian died.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，縉至自太原。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day gengshen, Wang Jin returned from Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on gengshen, Wang Jin returned from Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，承嗣為太尉。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day wushen, Tian Chengsi was made grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on wushen, Tian Chengsi was appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，載誅，縉貶括州刺史。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinsi, Yuan Zai was executed; Wang Jin was demoted to prefect of Kuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinsi, Yuan Zai was executed; Wang Jin was demoted to prefect of Kuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四月壬午，太常卿楊綰為中書侍郎，禮部侍郎常袞為門下侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day renwu, Yang Wan, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Chang Gun, vice minister of rites, was made vice director of the Chancellery—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on renwu, Yang Wan, minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat; Chang Gun, vice minister of rites, vice director of the Chancellery—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月己巳，綰薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jisi, Yang Wan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jisi, Yang Wan died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，前淮西節度使、檢校司空、同平章事李忠臣本官同平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingwei, Li Zhongchen, former military commissioner of Huai-Xi, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, retained his original office as Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei, Li Zhongchen, former military commissioner of Huai-Xi, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, retained his original rank as Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲戌，袞貶河南少尹。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month on the day jiaxu, Chang Gun was demoted to vice prefect of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month on jiaxu, Chang Gun was demoted to vice prefect of Henan.

sentences.zh: 河南少尹崔祐甫為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Youfu, vice prefect of Henan, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Youfu, vice prefect of Henan, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月甲辰，懷州刺史喬琳為御史大夫，道州司馬楊炎為門下侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiachen, Qiao Lin, prefect of Huai Prefecture, was made censor-in-chief; Yang Yan, vice prefect of Dao Prefecture, was made vice director of the Chancellery—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiachen, Qiao Lin, prefect of Huai Prefecture, was appointed censor-in-chief; Yang Yan, vice prefect of Dao Prefecture, vice director of the Chancellery—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，琳罷為工部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renwu, Qiao Lin was removed and made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renwu, Qiao Lin was dismissed and appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 二月癸未，承嗣死。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guiwei, Tian Chengsi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guiwei, Tian Chengsi died.

sentences.zh: 閏五月甲申，子儀加尚父，兼太尉、中書令。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month on the day jiashen, Guo Ziyi was advanced as Eminent Father and made concurrently grand commandant and secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month on jiashen, Guo Ziyi was advanced as Eminent Father and appointed concurrently grand commandant and secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥，平盧淄青節度使、檢校司空、同平章事李正己為司徒，成德軍節度使、檢校司空、同平章事李寶臣為司空。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jihai, Li Zhengji, military commissioner of Pinglu and Ziqing, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made minister of education; Li Baochen, military commissioner of Chengde, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jihai, Li Zhengji, military commissioner of Pinglu and Ziqing, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed minister of education; Li Baochen, military commissioner of Chengde, acting minister of works, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed minister of works.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午，祐甫薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiawu, Cui Youfu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiawu, Cui Youfu died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，炎為中書侍郎，御史大夫盧杞為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yisi, Yang Yan was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Lu Qi, censor-in-chief, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yisi, Yang Yan was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat; Lu Qi, censor-in-chief, vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，永平軍節度使張鎰為中書侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengshen, Zhang Yi, military commissioner of Yongping, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengshen, Zhang Yi, military commissioner of Yongping, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 炎罷為左僕射。

translations.literal: Yang Yan was removed and made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yan was dismissed and appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 正月戊辰，寶臣死。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day wuchen, Li Baochen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on wuchen, Li Baochen died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛丑，子儀薨。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinchou, Guo Ziyi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinchou, Guo Ziyi died.

sentences.zh: 七月庚申，檢校右僕射侯希逸為司空，是日卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengshen, Hou Xiyi, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made minister of works and died the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengshen, Hou Xiyi, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed minister of works and died the same day.

sentences.zh: 壬午，幽州隴右兼四鎮北庭行軍涇原節度使、檢校司空兼中書令朱泚為太尉。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Zhu Ci, military commissioner of Youzhou, Longyou, and the Four Garrisons and Beiting campaign, acting minister of works, and concurrently secretariat director, was made grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhu Ci, military commissioner of Youzhou, Longyou, and the Four Garrisons and Beiting campaign, acting minister of works, and concurrently secretariat director, was appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，正己死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinmao, Li Zhengji died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinmao, Li Zhengji died.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，鎰罷為鳳翔節度使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day wuyin, Zhang Yi was removed and made military commissioner of Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on wuyin, Zhang Yi was dismissed and appointed military commissioner of Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 十月丙辰，吏部侍郎關播為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingchen, Guan Bo, vice minister of the civil service, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingchen, Guan Bo, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，戶部尚書蕭復為吏部尚書，吏部郎中劉從一為刑部侍郎，京兆府戶曹參軍、翰林學士姜公輔為諫議大夫，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingsi, Xiao Fu, minister of revenue, was made minister of the civil service; Liu Congyi, director of the civil service bureau, was made vice minister of justice; Jiang Gongfu, capital household section staff member and Hanlin academician, was made remonstrance official—all Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingsi, Xiao Fu, minister of revenue, was appointed minister of the civil service; Liu Congyi, director of the civil service bureau, vice minister of justice; and Jiang Gongfu, capital household staff member and Hanlin academician, remonstrance official—all as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，朔方節度使李懷光為中書令、朔方邠寧同華陝虢河中晉絳慈隰行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day guisi, Li Huai'guang, military commissioner of Shuofang, was made secretariat director and deputy commander-in-chief of the Binning, Tonghua, Shaanxi, Guo, Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Long campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on guisi, Li Huai'guang, military commissioner of Shuofang, was appointed secretariat director and deputy commander-in-chief of the Binning, Tonghua, Shaanxi, Guo, Hezhong, Jin, Jiang, Ci, and Long campaign.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，杞貶新州司馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renxu, Lu Qi was demoted to vice prefect of Xin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renxu, Lu Qi was demoted to vice prefect of Xin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正月癸酉，播罷為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day guiyou, Guan Bo was removed and made minister of justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on guiyou, Guan Bo was dismissed and appointed minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，吏部侍郎盧翰為兵部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Lu Han, vice minister of the civil service, was made vice minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Lu Han, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed vice minister of war and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復為山南東西、荊湖、淮南、江西、鄂岳、浙江東西、福建、嶺南宣慰安撫使。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Xiao Fu was made commissioner for pacification of Shannan East and West, Jing-Hu, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Zhejiang East and West, Fujian, and Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Xiao Fu was appointed commissioner for pacification of Shannan East and West, Jing-Hu, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Zhejiang East and West, Fujian, and Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 四月甲寅，公輔罷為左庶子。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day jiayin, Jiang Gongfu was removed and made left aide.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on jiayin, Jiang Gongfu was dismissed and appointed left aide.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，李晟為中書令。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiyou, Li Sheng was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiyou, Li Sheng was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，從一為中書侍郎，翰為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Liu Congyi was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Lu Han was made vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Liu Congyi was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat, and Lu Han was appointed vice director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，朔方節度使、邠寧振武永平奉天行營兵馬副元帥、檢校尚書右僕射、同平章事渾瑊為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Hun Jian, military commissioner of Shuofang, deputy commander-in-chief of the Binning, Zhenwu, Yongping, and Fengtian campaign, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Hun Jian, military commissioner of Shuofang, deputy commander-in-chief of the Binning, Zhenwu, Yongping, and Fengtian campaign, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，忠臣誅。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Li Zhongchen was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Li Zhongchen was executed.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，瑊為河中、同絳、陝虢諸軍行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guimao, Hun Jian was made deputy commander-in-chief of the Hezhong, Tong-Jiang, Shaanxi, and Guo campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guimao, Hun Jian was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of the Hezhong, Tong-Jiang, Shaanxi, and Guo campaign.

sentences.zh: 丙午，瑊兼朔方行營兵馬副元帥。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Hun Jian was made concurrently deputy commander-in-chief of the Shuofang campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Hun Jian was appointed concurrently deputy commander-in-chief of the Shuofang campaign.

sentences.zh: 十月辛丑，檢校司徒李勉本官同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day xinchou, Li Mian, acting minister of education, retained his original office as Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on xinchou, Li Mian, acting minister of education, retained his original rank as Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，復罷為左庶子。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day chou, Xiao Fu was removed and made left aide.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on chou, Xiao Fu was dismissed and appointed left aide.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，勉加太清宮使，翰加太微宮使，從一集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jimao, Li Mian was additionally made commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace; Lu Han commissioner of the Grand Subtle Palace; Liu Congyi grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jimao, Li Mian was additionally appointed commissioner of the Grand Pure Palace; Lu Han commissioner of the Grand Subtle Palace; and Liu Congyi grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，李懷光為太尉，不拜。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day jiazi, Li Huai'guang was made grand commandant and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on jiazi, Li Huai'guang was appointed grand commandant but did not accept the appointment.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，京畿、渭北、商華兵馬副元帥李晟為司徒、中書令。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day jiyou, Li Sheng, deputy commander-in-chief of the capital region, Wei-Bei, and Shang-Hua military affairs, was made minister of education and secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on jiyou, Li Sheng, deputy commander-in-chief of the capital region, Wei-Bei, and Shang-Hua military affairs, was appointed minister of education and secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，晟為鳳翔隴右諸軍、涇原四鎮北庭行營兵馬元帥。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day guimao, Li Sheng was made commander-in-chief of the Fengxiang, Longyou, Jingyuan, Four Garrisons, and Beiting campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on guimao, Li Sheng was appointed commander-in-chief of the Fengxiang, Longyou, Jingyuan, Four Garrisons, and Beiting campaign.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，瑊為河中招撫使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day bingxu, Hun Jian was made commissioner for pacification of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on bingxu, Hun Jian was appointed commissioner for pacification of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，西川節度使、同平章事張延賞為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day xinmao, Zhang Yanshang, military commissioner of western Sichuan and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on xinmao, Zhang Yanshang, military commissioner of western Sichuan and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，河東節度使、檢校司徒、同平章事馬燧兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jimao, Ma Sui, military commissioner of Hedong, acting minister of education, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jimao, Ma Sui, military commissioner of Hedong, acting minister of education, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 延賞罷為左僕射。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanshang was removed and made left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanshang was dismissed and appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，從一罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day xinhai, Liu Congyi was removed and made minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on xinhai, Liu Congyi was dismissed and appointed minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，懷光伏誅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiaxu, Li Huai'guang was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiaxu, Li Huai'guang was executed.

sentences.zh: 正月壬寅，翰罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day renyin, Lu Han was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on renyin, Lu Han was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 吏部侍郎劉滋為左散騎常侍，給事中崔造，中書舍人齊映，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Liu Zi, vice minister of the civil service, was made left attendant-in-ordinary; Cui Zao, supervising secretary; and Qi Ying, drafting officer of the Secretariat—all Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zi, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed left attendant-in-ordinary; Cui Zao, supervising secretary; and Qi Ying, drafting officer of the Secretariat—all as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，映判兵部，勉判刑部，滋判吏部、禮部，造判戶部、工部。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Qi Ying directed the war ministry; Li Mian the justice ministry; Liu Zi the civil service and rites ministries; Cui Zao the revenue and works ministries.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Qi Ying was assigned the war ministry; Li Mian the justice ministry; Liu Zi the civil service and rites ministries; and Cui Zao the revenue and works ministries.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，燧為綏銀麟勝招討使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingsi, Ma Sui was made commissioner for pacification of Sui, Yin, Lin, and Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingsi, Ma Sui was appointed commissioner for pacification of Sui, Yin, Lin, and Sheng.

sentences.zh: 庚申，造罷為右庶子。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Cui Zao was removed and made right aide.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Cui Zao was dismissed and appointed right aide.
