sentences.zh: 正月壬寅，尚書左僕射張延賞同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day renyin, Zhang Yanshang, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on renyin, Zhang Yanshang, left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 壬子，滋罷守左散騎常侍，映貶夔州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Liu Zi was removed and retained as left attendant-in-ordinary; Qi Ying was demoted to prefect of Kui Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Liu Zi was dismissed and retained as left attendant-in-ordinary, and Qi Ying was demoted to prefect of Kui Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 兵部侍郎柳渾同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Liu Hun, vice minister of war, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hun, vice minister of war, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，燧罷副元帥。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day xinhai, Ma Sui was removed as deputy commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on xinhai, Ma Sui was relieved of the deputy command.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，陝虢觀察使李泌為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingxu, Li Bi, observer of Shaan-Guo, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingxu, Li Bi, observer of Shaan-Guo, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，延賞薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renshen, Zhang Yanshang died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renshen, Zhang Yanshang died.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，渾罷為散騎常侍。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jichou, Liu Hun was removed and made attendant-in-ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jichou, Liu Hun was dismissed and appointed attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，晟為太尉。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingwei, Li Sheng was made grand commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingwei, Li Sheng was appointed grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，馬燧為司徒兼侍中。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day bingxu, Ma Sui was made minister of education and concurrently palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on bingxu, Ma Sui was appointed minister of education and concurrently palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 七月庚戌，瑊為邠寧慶副元帥。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day gengxu, Hun Jian was made deputy commander-in-chief of Binning and Qing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on gengxu, Hun Jian was appointed deputy commander-in-chief of Binning and Qing.

sentences.zh: 二月庚子，御史大夫竇參為中書侍郎，大理卿董晉為門下侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day gengzi, Dou Can, censor-in-chief, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Dong Jin, grand justice, was made vice director of the Chancellery—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on gengzi, Dou Can, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat; Dong Jin, grand justice, vice director of the Chancellery—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，泌薨。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiachen, Li Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiachen, Li Bi died.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，參兼吏部尚書，知選事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day dingchou, Dou Can was made concurrently minister of the civil service and director of appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on dingchou, Dou Can was appointed concurrently minister of the civil service and director of appointments.

sentences.zh: 四月乙未，參貶郴州別駕。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day yiwei, Dou Can was demoted to aide of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on yiwei, Dou Can was demoted to aide of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尚書左丞趙憬、兵部侍郎陸贄並中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zhao Jing, left director of the Department of State Affairs, and Lu Zhi, vice minister of war, were made vice secretaries of the Secretariat and Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Jing, left director of the Department of State Affairs, and Lu Zhi, vice minister of war, were appointed vice secretaries of the Secretariat and Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月甲辰，憬為門下侍郎，義成軍節度使賈耽為尚書右僕射，尚書右丞盧邁，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day jiachen, Zhao Jing was made vice director of the Chancellery; Jia Dan, military commissioner of Yicheng, was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; Lu Mai, right director of the Department of State Affairs—all Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on jiachen, Zhao Jing was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Jia Dan, military commissioner of Yicheng, right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; and Lu Mai, right director of the Department of State Affairs—all as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，晉罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on the day bingwu, Dong Jin was removed and made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on bingwu, Dong Jin was dismissed and appointed minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 正月己亥，抱真讓司徒，為檢校左僕射。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day jihai, Li Baozhen declined the ministry of education and was made acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on jihai, Li Baozhen declined the ministry of education and was appointed acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，抱真卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day renyin, Li Baozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on renyin, Li Baozhen died.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，晟薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day gengxu, Li Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on gengxu, Li Sheng died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，贄罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renxu, Lu Zhi was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renxu, Lu Zhi was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 正月乙亥，邁為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day yihai, Lu Mai was made vice secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on yihai, Lu Mai was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，燧薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinhai, Ma Sui died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinhai, Ma Sui died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑，瑊兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day chou, Hun Jian was made concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on chou, Hun Jian was appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，憬薨。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day bingxu, Zhao Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on bingxu, Zhao Jing died.

sentences.zh: 十月甲戌，右諫議大夫崔損、給事中趙宗儒並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiaxu, Cui Sun, right remonstrance official, and Zhao Zongru, supervising secretary, were made Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiaxu, Cui Sun, right remonstrance official, and Zhao Zongru, supervising secretary, were appointed Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，邁罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jichou, Lu Mai was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jichou, Lu Mai was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四月丁丑，損為脩八陵使。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingchou, Cui Sun was made commissioner for repair of the eight imperial tombs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingchou, Cui Sun was appointed commissioner for repair of the eight imperial tombs.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，宗儒罷為太子右庶子。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day renshen, Zhao Zongru was removed and made right aide to the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on renshen, Zhao Zongru was dismissed and appointed right aide to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎鄭餘慶為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zheng Yuyu, vice minister of works, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuyu, vice minister of works, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 損為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: Cui Sun was made vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Sun was appointed vice director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，瑊薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day xinwei, Hun Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on xinwei, Hun Jian died.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，餘慶貶郴州司馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengxu, Zheng Yuyu was demoted to vice prefect of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengxu, Zheng Yuyu was demoted to vice prefect of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太常卿齊抗為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Qi Kang, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Qi Kang, minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，淮南節度使、檢校尚書左僕射、同平章事杜佑檢校司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day renzi, Du You, military commissioner of Huainan, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made acting minister of works and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on renzi, Du You, military commissioner of Huainan, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed acting minister of works and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月己未，抗罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day jiwei, Qi Kang was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on jiwei, Qi Kang was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月丁巳，損薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eleventh month on the day dingsi, Cui Sun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month on dingsi, Cui Sun died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，太常卿高郢為中書侍郎，吏部侍郎鄭珣瑜為門下侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengshen, Gao Ying, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat; Zheng Xunyu, vice minister of the civil service, was made vice director of the Chancellery—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengshen, Gao Ying, minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat; Zheng Xunyu, vice minister of the civil service, vice director of the Chancellery—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，吏部侍郎韋執誼為尚書右丞、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day xinhai, Wei Zhiyi, vice minister of the civil service, was made right director of the Department of State Affairs and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on xinhai, Wei Zhiyi, vice minister of the civil service, was appointed right director of the Department of State Affairs and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，佑檢校司徒。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day bingxu, Du You was made acting minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on bingxu, Du You was appointed acting minister of education.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，郢為刑部尚書，珣瑜為吏部尚書，執誼為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Gao Ying was made minister of justice; Zheng Xunyu minister of the civil service; Wei Zhiyi vice secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Gao Ying was appointed minister of justice; Zheng Xunyu minister of the civil service; and Wei Zhiyi vice secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 七月乙未，郢罷守刑部尚書，珣瑜罷守吏部尚書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day yiwei, Gao Ying was removed and retained as minister of justice; Zheng Xunyu was removed and retained as minister of the civil service.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on yiwei, Gao Ying was dismissed and retained as minister of justice, and Zheng Xunyu was dismissed and retained as minister of the civil service.

sentences.zh: 太常卿杜黃裳為門下侍郎，左金吾衛大將軍袁滋為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Du Huangxiang, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made vice director of the Chancellery; Yuan Zi, left general of the Golden Crow Guard, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huangxiang, minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Yuan Zi, left general of the Golden Crow Guard, vice secretary of the Secretariat—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，滋為劍南東西川、山南西道安撫大使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiwei, Yuan Zi was made commissioner for pacification of eastern and western Sichuan and Shannan West.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiwei, Yuan Zi was appointed commissioner for pacification of eastern and western Sichuan and Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，尚書左丞鄭餘慶同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zheng Yuyu was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Zheng Yuyu was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，耽薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingyou, Jia Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingyou, Jia Dan died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，滋罷為檢校吏部尚書、同平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Yuan Zi was removed and made acting minister of the civil service, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Yuan Zi was dismissed and appointed acting minister of the civil service, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，執誼貶崖州司馬。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day renshen, Wei Zhiyi was demoted to vice prefect of Ya Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on renshen, Wei Zhiyi was demoted to vice prefect of Ya Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，中書舍人鄭絪為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day renxu, Zheng Yin, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on renxu, Zheng Yin, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，餘慶罷為河南尹。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengxu, Zheng Yuyu was removed and made chief administrator of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengxu, Zheng Yuyu was dismissed and appointed chief administrator of Henan.

sentences.zh: 四月丁未，佑為司徒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day dingwei, Du You was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on dingwei, Du You was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 正月乙巳，黃裳罷為檢校司空、同平章事、河中節度使。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day yisi, Du Huangxiang was removed and made acting minister of works, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on yisi, Du Huangxiang was dismissed and appointed acting minister of works, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，御史中丞武元衡為門下侍郎，中書舍人李吉甫為中書侍郎，並同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Wu Yuanheng, vice censor-in-chief, was made vice director of the Chancellery; Li Jifu, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat—both Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Wu Yuanheng, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Li Jifu, drafting officer of the Secretariat, vice secretary of the Secretariat—both as Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，元衡兼判戶部；

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day xinyou, Wu Yuanheng was made concurrently director of the revenue ministry;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on xinyou, Wu Yuanheng was appointed concurrently director of the revenue ministry;

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，檢校吏部尚書兼門下侍郎、同平章事、西川節度使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day dingmao, he was made acting minister of the civil service and concurrently vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on dingmao, Wu Yuanheng was appointed acting minister of the civil service and concurrently vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，山南東道節度使、檢校尚書左僕射于頔守司空、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengyin, Yu Di, military commissioner of Shannan East, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made acting minister of works and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengyin, Yu Di, military commissioner of Shannan East, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed acting minister of works and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 丙申，戶部侍郎裴垍守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事，絪為門下侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Pei Ji, vice minister of revenue, was made acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Zheng Yin was made vice director of the Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Pei Ji, vice minister of revenue, was appointed acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Zheng Yin was appointed vice director of the Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，吉甫檢校兵部尚書兼中書侍郎、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Li Jifu was made acting minister of war and concurrently vice secretary of the Secretariat, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Li Jifu was appointed acting minister of war and concurrently vice secretary of the Secretariat, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，頔守司空。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day gengyin, Yu Di was made acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on gengyin, Yu Di was appointed acting minister of works.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，絪罷為太子賓客。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingmao, Zheng Yin was removed and made guest of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingmao, Zheng Yin was dismissed and appointed guest of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 給事中李藩為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Fan, supervising secretary, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan, supervising secretary, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅，太常卿權德輿為禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day bingyin, Quan Deyu, minister of imperial sacrifices, was made minister of rites and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on bingyin, Quan Deyu, minister of imperial sacrifices, was appointed minister of rites and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，罷為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day gengshen, he was removed and made minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on gengshen, Quan Deyu was dismissed and appointed minister of war.

sentences.zh: 正月庚申，李吉甫為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day gengshen, Li Jifu was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on gengshen, Li Jifu was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，藩罷為太子詹事。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day renshen, Li Fan was removed and made grand steward of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on renshen, Li Fan was dismissed and appointed grand steward of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，戶部侍郎李絳為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on the day jichou, Li Jiang, vice minister of revenue, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month on jichou, Li Jiang, vice minister of revenue, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，佑為太保致仕。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guisi, Du You retired as grand guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guisi, Du You retired as grand guardian.

sentences.zh: 正月辛未，德輿罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day xinwei, Quan Deyu was removed and made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on xinwei, Quan Deyu was dismissed and appointed minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，武元衡為門下侍郎、平章事；

translations.literal: In the third month on the day jiazi, Wu Yuanheng was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery;
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiazi, Wu Yuanheng was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery;

sentences.zh: 己巳，至自西川。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he returned from western Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, Wu Yuanheng returned from western Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，頔貶恩王傅。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day dingyou, Yu Di was demoted to tutor of the Prince of En.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on dingyou, Yu Di was demoted to tutor of the Prince of En.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，絳罷為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day guimao, Li Jiang was removed and made minister of rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on guimao, Li Jiang was dismissed and appointed minister of rites.

sentences.zh: 六月壬寅，河中節度使張弘靖為刑部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day renyin, Zhang Hongjing, military commissioner of Hezhong, was made minister of justice and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on renyin, Zhang Hongjing, military commissioner of Hezhong, was appointed minister of justice and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，吉甫薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day bingwu, Li Jifu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on bingwu, Li Jifu died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，弘靖守中書侍郎。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day gengxu, Zhang Hongjing was made acting vice secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on gengxu, Zhang Hongjing was appointed acting vice secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，尚書右丞韋貫之同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Wei Guanzhi, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Wei Guanzhi, right director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，元衡為盜殺。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on the day guimao, Wu Yuanheng was murdered by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month on guimao, Wu Yuanheng was murdered by bandits.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，御史中丞裴度為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Pei Du, vice censor-in-chief, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Pei Du, vice censor-in-chief, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 正月乙酉，宣武軍節度使韓弘守司徒。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day yiyou, Han Hong, military commissioner of Xuanwu, was made acting minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on yiyou, Han Hong, military commissioner of Xuanwu, was appointed acting minister of education.

sentences.zh: 正月己巳，弘靖罷檢校吏部尚書、河東節度使。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day jisi, Zhang Hongjing was removed as acting minister of the civil service and military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on jisi, Zhang Hongjing was relieved of the acting civil service ministry and the Hedong military commissionership.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，中書舍人李逢吉為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事，貫之為中書侍郎。

translations.literal: In the second month on the day yisi, Li Fengji, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery; Wei Guanzhi was made vice secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month on yisi, Li Fengji, drafting officer of the Secretariat, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Wei Guanzhi was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，貫之罷為吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renyin, Wei Guanzhi was removed and made vice minister of the civil service.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renyin, Wei Guanzhi was dismissed and appointed vice minister of the civil service.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，翰林學士、工部侍郎王涯為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day dingwei, Wang Ya, Hanlin academician and vice minister of works, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on dingwei, Wang Ya, Hanlin academician and vice minister of works, was appointed vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，度守門下侍郎、同平章事、彰義節度、淮西宣慰處置使，戶部侍郎崔群為中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day bingchen, Pei Du was made acting vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, military commissioner of Zhangyi, and commissioner for pacification of Huai-Xi; Cui Qun, vice minister of revenue, was made vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on bingchen, Pei Du was appointed acting vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, military commissioner of Zhangyi, and commissioner for pacification of Huai-Xi; Cui Qun, vice minister of revenue, vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月丁未，逢吉罷為劍南東川節度使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day dingwei, Li Fengji was removed and made military commissioner of eastern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on dingwei, Li Fengji was dismissed and appointed military commissioner of eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十月甲戌，淮南節度使、檢校尚書右僕射李鄘為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month on the day jiaxu, Li Fu, military commissioner of Huainan, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month on jiaxu, Li Fu, military commissioner of Huainan, acting right vice director of the Department of State Affairs, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，鄘至。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day wuyin, Li Fu arrived.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on wuyin, Li Fu arrived at court.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，鄘罷為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: In the third month on the day wuxu, Li Fu was removed and made minister of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on wuxu, Li Fu was dismissed and appointed minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 御史大夫李夷簡為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Li Yijian, censor-in-chief, was made vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yijian, censor-in-chief, was appointed vice director of the Chancellery and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月辛丑，夷簡檢校左僕射、同平章事、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day xinchou, Li Yijian was made acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on xinchou, Li Yijian was appointed acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Huainan.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，涯罷為兵部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day renzi, Wang Ya was removed and made vice minister of war.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on renzi, Wang Ya was dismissed and appointed vice minister of war.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，戶部侍郎、判度支皇甫鎛，工部侍郎、諸道鹽鐵轉運使程異，並同中書門下平章事，判使各如故。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day jiachen, Huangfu Bo, vice minister of revenue and director of the revenue bureau, and Cheng Yi, vice minister of works and commissioner of salt-iron transport, were made Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, each retaining his commissionership.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on jiachen, Huangfu Bo, vice minister of revenue and director of the revenue bureau, and Cheng Yi, vice minister of works and commissioner of salt-iron transport, were appointed Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, each retaining his commissionership.

sentences.zh: 四月辛未，異薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month on the day xinwei, Cheng Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month on xinwei, Cheng Yi died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，度檢校左僕射，兼門下侍郎、同平章事、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Pei Du was made acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Pei Du was appointed acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrently vice director of the Chancellery, Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and military commissioner of Hedong.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，鎛守門下侍郎，河陽節度使令狐楚守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dingyou, Huangfu Bo was made acting vice director of the Chancellery; Linghu Chu, military commissioner of Heyang, was made acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingyou, Huangfu Bo was appointed acting vice director of the Chancellery; Linghu Chu, military commissioner of Heyang, acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，宣武節度使、守司徒兼侍中，同平章事韓弘兼中書令。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day jiyou, Han Hong, military commissioner of Xuanwu, acting minister of education and concurrently palace attendant, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was made concurrently secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on jiyou, Han Hong, military commissioner of Xuanwu, acting minister of education and concurrently palace attendant, and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery, was appointed concurrently secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，群罷為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on the day jimao, Cui Qun was removed and made observer of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on jimao, Cui Qun was dismissed and appointed observer of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 正月壬午，鎛罷度支。

translations.literal: In the first month on the day renwu, Huangfu Bo was removed as director of the revenue bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month on renwu, Huangfu Bo was relieved of the revenue directorship.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁未，鎛貶崖州司戶參軍。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on the day dingwei, Huangfu Bo was demoted to registrar of Ya Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month on dingwei, Huangfu Bo was demoted to registrar of Ya Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，楚為門下侍郎，御史中丞蕭俛、中書舍人翰林學士段文昌並守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Linghu Chu was made vice director of the Chancellery; Xiao Mian, vice censor-in-chief, and Duan Wenchang, drafting officer of the Secretariat and Hanlin academician, were made acting vice secretaries of the Secretariat and Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Linghu Chu was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Xiao Mian, vice censor-in-chief, and Duan Wenchang, drafting officer of the Secretariat and Hanlin academician, acting vice secretaries of the Secretariat and Counsellors jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，楚罷為宣歙觀察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh month on the day dingmao, Linghu Chu was removed and made observer of Xuan-She.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month on dingmao, Linghu Chu was dismissed and appointed observer of Xuan-She.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，俛為門下侍郎，御史中丞崔植守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on the day wuxu, Xiao Mian was made vice director of the Chancellery; Cui Zhi, vice censor-in-chief, was made acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month on wuxu, Xiao Mian was appointed vice director of the Chancellery; Cui Zhi, vice censor-in-chief, acting vice secretary of the Secretariat and Counsellor jointly deliberating on affairs of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，檢校左僕射、河東節度使裴度守司空。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on the day wuwu, Pei Du, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and military commissioner of Hedong, was made acting minister of works.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on wuwu, Pei Du, acting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs and military commissioner of Hedong, was appointed acting minister of works.
